Game Overview

In Poppy Strike 4, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a maze of eerie backrooms, using your wits and weapons to evade relentless Huggy Wuggy mascots. In Poppy Strike 4, tension builds as you strategically move and listen for danger. Survive the nightmare, adapt to new challenges, and escape the clutches of this unpredictable horror realm.
